marketing_description: The United Window & Door 4500 Series Sliding Patio Door, part number 1517602, features a vinyl door and frame, with a door width of 71-1/2 in and door height of 79-1/2 in. This door is designed with a LowE Arg w/J door finish and includes features such as Dual Corrosion-Resistant Rollers and a Dual-Walled Sill Tower. The door is available in a Black/White color option and has a 1-Point Mortise locking type.
